title: Fresh Fold — Laundry Management System
description: A full-stack Java Spring MVC application designed to manage user registrations, logins, orders, and laundry operations. Built step-by-step with each feature in separate commits for clarity. Demonstrates clean MVC architecture, role-based access, and end-to-end service management.
features: Service catalog with pricing and order tracking
Admin dashboard for order, customer & staff management

title: PCForge — Computer Shop & Custom PC Builder Platform
description: A full-stack, cross-platform e-commerce and custom PC building ecosystem modelled on enthusiast computer retail. Customers design custom rigs with real-time hardware compatibility validation, LangGraph AI agents recommend specifications and reserve inventory, store technicians review builds in a dedicated web portal, and after-sales workflows handle RMA and appointment scheduling.
features: Custom PC builder with live wattage, CPU–motherboard socket, DDR generation and form-factor compatibility checks
Five specialised LangGraph AI agents: requirements, inventory, build, order planning and after-sales
React staff portal with KPI dashboard, build-review queue, inventory, orders and service requests
Flutter (Material 3) Android client with catalog search, barcode scanner and appointment management
JWT role-based access (Admin / Staff / Customer), email notifications, CI pipeline and test suites on every tier
captions: Staff portal — system overview dashboard with live operational KPIs
Staff portal — inventory management with stock status and quick adjustments
Staff portal — hardware catalog with product management
Staff portal — secure sign-in for authorised staff
note: Additional project — repository owned by thisal-d. Screenshots are from the live staff portal, which requires a staff sign-in.

title: Fresh Fold Laundry — Admin Module
description: Admin module for the Fresh Fold Laundry Management System built using Java, JSP, and Servlets. Allows administrators to manage users, track orders, update laundry status, handle payments, and monitor overall system performance.

title: Fitness Membership Management System
description: A simple fitness center membership management system built using Java, JSP, and Servlets with file handling. Allows users to register, view current memberships, and manage membership plans. Designed using OOP concepts and basic HTML/CSS for the interface.

title: SQL Basics for Beginners
description: A simple SQL project for beginners to learn basic data types, ER diagram drawing, and table creation with examples. Includes SQL practice queries, joins, stored procedures, and database design exercises — useful for learning and revising SQL concepts.
features: SQL query practice with real schemas
